summary: Under ADR-0096 ordinary verification, current-composition-local.py --published-all read every custody archive of Rendering 0.32.3 from the public NuGet flat container without credentials and ran the producer's own compare against the once-read custody archives (producer 4ec6eaf, custody sha 7dbd4329...). All 19 pass payload-exact, each published archive carries exactly one feed .signature.p7s and adds 13,089 or 13,090 bytes; the three typed packages also equal their typed signed SHA-256. The result is a dated observation of live feed content, not installed adoption. Example composition: the #4818 Done-when elements (local save-replay, external receipts/reconnect without replay, transformed pointer/keyboard/IME/focus, held release, DOM islands, command ordering/coalescing/replacement/disposal) each map to executing typed cases among the 27 (blur/visibilitychange release, native textboxes with IME beside retained SVG, one-request projection coalescing, stale-generation inertness, disposal counts of zero); see docs/reports/2026-10-24-local-dom-composition.md. Not covered, hence the final remaining composition piece: broader DOM panels beyond one textbox (capability map F04) and a fresh installed receiver; that changes shipped template source and belongs with the next Workspace.Template release together with a durable reference localSaved journey. Durable product save belongs to FourD under #4819. AT stays with #4817.
title: All 19 Rendering 0.32.3 archives match custody at payload level; the DOM example composition is fully exercised except broader panels
